name: Thompson Zihuatanejo
insider_take: This sophisticated beachfront retreat sits on Playa La Ropa, one of Mexico's most pristine Pacific coast beaches, where local fishermen still launch their pangas at sunrise.
whats_special: Thompson Zihuatanejo occupies a dramatic clifftop location with panoramic views of Zihuatanejo Bay. The property features indigenous Guerrero craftsmanship throughout, including hand-painted Talavera tiles and locally-sourced stone work. As part of Hyatt's Privé program, guests enjoy exclusive perks like daily breakfast and resort credits.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view suite during whale watching season (December-March) when humpback whales migrate through these waters – you can spot them right from your terrace.
dont_miss: The hotel's Ni restaurant showcases locally-caught red snapper and mahi-mahi prepared with indigenous Purépecha cooking techniques. Take the complimentary shuttle to downtown Zihuatanejo's fish market, where the same boats that supply the hotel's kitchen dock daily with their catch.
pros: Beachfront location on pristine Playa La Ropa
Hyatt Privé program benefits and amenities
Sophisticated design with authentic Mexican charm
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
Remote location in smaller coastal town
